_about: Semantic slot vocabulary for custom emoji icon systems. Each slot is a MEANING. `unicode` lists acceptable Unicode equivalents in order of preference: the first one is the default fallback when no sticker resolves; when a sticker resolves, its own `emoji` field becomes the fallback (official recommendation). `label` is the text-only fallback (empty = the accent is simply dropped). `use` says where the slot belongs: button, title, inline (inside running text), status (reserved state marks), post_accent (channel posts / long texts). Matching ignores U+FE0F, so '⚙' and '⚙️' are the same key. Heuristic content of this skill, checked 2026-11-15. `words` (en, ru, uk) are the label words a button carrying this slot's icon may say; a trailing * matches any ending. bot-ui validate (ICON_MEANING_MISMATCH) and the icon review sheet flag a button whose label says another slot's words and none of its icon's.

menu.label: Menu
menu.note: Opens the main menu; prefer words on the menu button itself.

back.label: Back
back.note: Pick ONE arrow pair for the whole bot; often clearer as a word only.

forward.label: Next
forward.note: Pairs with back; same family and weight.

previous_page.label: Previous page
previous_page.note: Pagination; keep the page number in words.

next_page.label: Next page
next_page.note: Pagination; keep the page number in words.

close.label: Close
close.note: Dismiss a panel; not the same id as delete or error.

open_link.label: Open
open_link.note: External link button; the URL itself carries the action.

external.label: Open in browser
external.note: Leaves Telegram; say where in the label.

refresh.label: Refresh
refresh.note: Re-fetch; not the same id as sync/convert.

reload.label: Reload
reload.note: Hard reload; use refresh unless both exist.

remove.label: Remove
remove.note: Remove from a list without deleting data.

rename.label: Rename
rename.note: Often shares the edit glyph; use different ids only if both appear.

delete.label: Delete
delete.note: Destructive; pair with style danger and a confirmation.

copy.label: Copy
copy.note: Use the copy_text button for one copyable value.

search.label: Search
search.note: Pick one magnifier; 🔍 and 🔎 are two symbols.

attach.label: Attach
attach.note: Attach a file to a form.

stop.label: Stop
stop.note: Stop a process or a stream.

like.label: Like
like.note: Feedback; not the same as confirm.

favorite.label: Favorite
favorite.note: Saved/starred; reserve ⭐ if Stars prices are shown.

done.label: Done
done.note: Reserved: completed/confirmed. Not a settings icon.

confirm.label: Confirm
confirm.note: Commit button; often shares done's glyph, use one id for both.

success.label: Success
success.note: Success screen title; keep animation for this one moment if any.

verified.label: Verified
verified.note: Verification mark; never imitate Telegram's own badge.

pay.label: Pay
pay.note: Payment button; pay buttons must stay first in invoices.

stars.label: Stars
stars.note: Telegram Stars amount; keep distinct from favorite.

premium.label: Premium
premium.note: Paid tier; distinct from Telegram Premium branding.

bitcoin.label: Bitcoin
bitcoin.note: BTC sign; Unicode fallback is a currency sign, not an emoji.

settings.label: Settings
settings.note: Bot settings; one gear meaning per bot.

logout.label: Log out
logout.note: Sign out; not the same id as exit/close.

add_user.label: Add member
add_user.note: Invite/add member; combine words, not two icons.

ai.label: AI
ai.note: AI feature entry; ✨ is overused, pick one.

thinking.label: Thinking
thinking.note: Use the official AIActions set inside <tg-thinking>.

sparkle.label: Highlight
sparkle.note: Accent; at most one per post.

caution.label: Caution
caution.note: Softer warning; shares warning's glyph, use one id.

help.label: Help
help.note: Help screen; pick question or help, not both.

headline.note: One accent before a post headline.

section.note: Section marker before a bold sub-heading.

bullet.note: List bullet; use for at most one list per post.

cta.note: Before the call to action line; one per post.

divider.note: Never a row of emoji; one glyph or none.

number_1.note: Numbered step; numbers are clearer as plain digits.

price_mark.note: Price line in a promo post.

hot.note: Hot/limited; a common overuse - at most once.
